    | timestamp = 00:15:04.940
    | text      = You didn't hear that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:05.779
    | text      = No. Ooh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.779
    | text      = What is Dark Maga?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:08.480
    | text      = He wore a black hat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:09.840
    | text      = Oh, for God's sakes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:10.919
    | text      = Yeah. What are we doing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:12.080
    | text      = Evil Dark Maga.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:14.440
    | text      = Why would you want evil?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:16.039
    | text      = You're not supposed to be evil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:18.360
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:19.179
    | text      = Sometimes you need the Suicide Squad
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:21.360
    | text      = to come and solve some problems.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.200
    | text      = I don't want the richest man in the world on this squad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.240
    | text      = I mean, I guess I do want him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:27.440
    | text      = on that specific squad only though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:29.960
    | text      = The richest man in the world is Dark Maga.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:31.879
    | text      = Oh my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:33.080
    | text      = That's bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:34.200
    | text      = That's bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:35.039
    | text      = Yeah, it is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:36.080
    | text      = That's just bad on a just life level,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:39.840
    | text      = but also on a personal level.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:41.679
    | text      = You should be aiming for higher than Dark Maga.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:44.600
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:45.480
    | text      = Yeah, it's embarrassing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:46.320
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:47.159
    | text      = So it's also really funny how Alex kept pretending
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:49.320
    | text      = that he was concerned about people like Jack Dorsey
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:51.580
    | text      = being too political while they were running websites
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:54.080
    | text      = that are essentially the public square,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:56.279
    | text      = but now Elon is a comical level of political
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.679
    | text      = and Alex can't get enough of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:00.159
    | text      = He's fighting a hundred percent for team humanity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.759
    | text      = Oh, fuck yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.000
    | text      = This is a great illustration of how Alex uses fake positions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:07.120
    | text      = to try to reach more people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:08.840
    | text      = His problem was never that someone like Jack or Zuckerberg
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:11.320
    | text      = was too political,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:12.159
    | text      = it's that they were saying political stuff he didn't like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:14.879
    | text      = That's a pretty weak argument to try to make
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:17.000
    | text      = and you're not going to win many people over with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:18.820
    | text      = So opposing any politicization of people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:21.320
    | text      = who run social media sites
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.600
    | text      = is a much stronger way to present yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.600
    | text      = At the time, this was pretty safe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:27.600
    | text      = because all the heads of social media
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:29.340
    | text      = who are relevant public figures
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.919
    | text      = were presentable as globalists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.320
    | text      = This is a place where you can secretly hold
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.159
    | text      = a pretty partisan position,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:36.759
    | text      = but pretend you're coming from this place
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:38.559
    | text      = of like your principles.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:40.519
    | text      = Then when Musk comes along
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:41.960
    | text      = and is the most embarrassingly political person
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.159
    | text      = you could imagine as the head of a social media company,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.919
    | text      = but he's supporting Trump,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:48.379
    | text      = this is no longer a principle thing because it never was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:51.600
    | text      = It was a trick that Alex was pulling on the audience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.139
    | text      = People who run social media platforms
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:57.039
    | text      = have an outsized influence
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:58.980
    | text      = and should have some measure of neutrality
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:01.240
    | text      = is a compelling position
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.539
    | text      = that a lot of people can get behind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:04.319
    | text      = Conversely, people who run social media platforms
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:07.019
    | text      = have an outsized level of influence
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:08.680
    | text      = and should have some measure of neutrality
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:10.400
    | text      = unless they're on my side is less so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:13.160
    | text      = That is less convincing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:14.539
    | text      = but that's what Alex is embodying and it's sad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:17.599
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, it is a little bit like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:21.839
    | text      = I understand people being fans of the home team,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:25.079
    | text      = you know, but if you went out to watch like a football game
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:31.920
    | text      = and one of the teams was forced
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:34.599
    | text      = to be inside of the ground dead,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:38.380
    | text      = it would not be an interesting game.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:40.660
    | text      = Nah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.500
    | text      = No, you have to have equal teams on both sides.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:45.119
    | text      = Yeah, and like liking the home team is great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:50.619
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:51.460
    | text      = Pretending that you like the home team
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:53.000
    | text      = because they're the only ones who understand the sport
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:55.859
    | text      = or something, it's...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:58.319
    | text      = Yeah, you're describing Cardinals fans, it makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:00.680
    | text      = Well, that's different.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:01.900
    | text      = That makes perfect sense, you've explained everything, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:05.960
    | text      = They play the game the right way, Dan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:07.839
    | text      = I'm not a Cardinals fan, I can't speak on this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:12.079
    | text      = So I just, I felt like these two days,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:14.339
    | text      = this Friday and Sunday were just disasters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:17.579
    | text      = There was so much just trying to promote
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:19.400
    | text      = his Give Send Go campaign,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:22.039
    | text      = trying to get people to give him money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:24.279
    | text      = He leaves halfway through the Sunday show,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:26.519
    | text      = Chase Geiser just takes over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:28.400
    | text      = He's playing the clip of Elon at the rally
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:30.799
    | text      = and it's just like, oh God, what a disaster.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:32.640
    | text      = That's gross.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:33.460
    | text      = So then we get to the seventh
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:34.920
    | text      = and Monday, business picks up a little bit
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:39.279
    | text      = because Alex has seen a video that John Stossel made
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:42.759
    | text      = that someone else named Elon Musk retweeted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:45.400
    | text      = about how Native Americans aren't so great after all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:48.000
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:49.039
    | text      = Also, John Stossel's put out a great report
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:50.880
    | text      = that Elon reposted, but he doesn't go all the way
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:53.440
    | text      = and I want to play this report about Native Americans
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:57.039
    | text      = and then give you the rest of the story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:58.799
    | text      = And I'm not attacking Native Americans.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:00.079
    | text      = I'm a little bit Native American myself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:02.240
    | text      = My great grandmother was half Native American,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:05.200
    | text      = my dad's grandmother, and I respect Native Americans.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:08.519
    | text      = But that said, the way they push them,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:11.880
    | text      = like they were these little angel cakes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:13.240
    | text      = and perfect is pure crap.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:14.359
    | text      = And if you understand that lie,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:15.859
    | text      = they push all the other lies that are going on
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:19.279
    | text      = and unfolding, so we're going to hit that as well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:21.180
    | text      = But right as I was going live,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:23.759
    | text      = I learned of an emergency
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:28.200
    | text      = today that could potentially shut us down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:31.400
    | text      = That's how crazy this is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:32.799
    | text      = And I'm just very calmly handling it all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.279
    | text      = I was already planning to play some excerpts
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:37.000
    | text      = of Saturday's incredible rally
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:38.559
    | text      = when Trump returned to Butler.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:40.579
    | text      = And I was already planning to get to that later,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:41.880
    | text      = but I'm going to have to go deal with this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:42.880
    | text      = for a few minutes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:43.720
    | text      = It might just take five, 10 minutes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.720
    | text      = That's how crazy it is right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:45.799
    | text      = I have to make the decisions, I have to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:47.900
    | text      = And then I will come back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.839
    | text      = Yeah, so Alex has to go off air again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:52.000
    | text      = But John Stossel, so what he did is he did a piece
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:56.200
    | text      = where he interviewed a guy who wrote a book
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:58.079
    | text      = called Lies My Liberal Teacher Taught Me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:00.240
    | text      = And most of the video that Stossel made
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:02.200
    | text      = seems to be about how the animated Pocahontas movie
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:04.859
    | text      = isn't real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:05.700
    | text      = It's not real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:07.039
    | text      = It is not real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:08.240
    | text      = And I hope your teachers didn't teach you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:10.119
    | text      = that it was real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:11.079
    | text      = Yeah, and I guess Elon reposted a clip of this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:14.119
    | text      = and everyone's mad about it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:15.160
    | text      = so it's the top story of the day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:16.680
    | text      = Oh my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:17.500
    | text      = This is wild.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:19.259
    | text      = I never really expected to turn on the show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:21.279
    | text      = and it be like, you know what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.319
    | text      = Fuck Pocahontas.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:25.160
    | text      = What are we doing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:26.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:27.319
    | text      = What are we,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:28.160
    | text      = I mean, when is enough enough
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:34.400
    | text      = for one culture to another?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:37.279
    | text      = When is enough?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:38.440
    | text      = Just say enough, guys.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:39.839
    | text      = Well, for Alex, enough is enough
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:41.559
    | text      = once someone gives him a call that there's an emergency.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:45.480
    | text      = So he had to get off air.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:46.519
    | text      = That's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.359
    | text      = And I hate that this train of thought was disrupted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.279
    | text      = and we don't get to hear more about his feelings
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.799
    | text      = about John Stossel's great Pocahontas video.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:54.240
    | text      = If only.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.059
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.900
    | text      = I know every rock and every creature has a voice
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:58.000
    | text      = and a spirit and a name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:59.240
    | text      = Well, very specifically,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:00.799
    | text      = that's what they're talking about not being true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:03.200
    | text      = God damn it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:04.039
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:04.859
    | text      = That song.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:07.000
    | text      = So Alex comes back about a half hour into the show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:10.440
    | text      = and we realize what happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:13.279
    | text      = I'm going on air,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:53:12.579
    | text      = a dangerous perspective to have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:13.940
    | text      = Maybe a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:15.019
    | text      = The second is that you have to conform.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:18.139
    | text      = A grade isn't inherent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:19.619
    | text      = It's at the discretion of a teacher.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:21.380
    | text      = Everyone knows that, and in order to always get A's,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:24.380
    | text      = you need to have a really keen sense
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:26.260
    | text      = of what each teacher wants and what each class is about,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:29.420
    | text      = and then do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:31.619
    | text      = This view leaves no space for creativity and taking risks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:35.500
    | text      = Some of the most rewarding experiences from school
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:37.860
    | text      = in my life were projects that I did
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:39.900
    | text      = where I did not get good grades,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:41.820
    | text      = but the act of doing the project taught me something new,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:44.980
    | text      = and maybe expanded what I felt I could do,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:47.860
    | text      = and sometimes it was a failure,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:49.579
    | text      = but you learn through that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:51.300
    | text      = The way Tucker views his children's education
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:53.500
    | text      = is a method of control, and that's a real bummer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Everything about him is a strange new type of bummer,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:00.460
    | text      = actually, and I find that to be just like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = oh, you're on stage talking about how your kids
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:06.820
    | text      = need to apologize for getting B's.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:09.260
    | text      = This is good.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = This is interesting content.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah, because he's deeply unsettling,

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = ah, I hate all foreigners.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It is deeply unsettling who you are as a person without that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:28.539
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, I was watching your show,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:30.820
    | text      = and you gave me strong vibes of someone
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:33.019
    | text      = who would make their kids apologize for getting a B,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:35.019
    | text      = but now it turns out that's because you are that guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:37.500
    | text      = That is, there's a part of me, genuinely,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Not good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:35.659
    | text      = So anyway, this goes on with him talking

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:37.699
    | text      = about the J-6 people and how they're heroes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = They are.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = The overwhelming majority of them

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = in the process of being overthrown, which it has been.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And they're the villains?

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:05.780
    | text      = You're not the radical.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:06.940
    | text      = I'm often called radical.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:07.900
    | text      = I'm the least radical person you ever met.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:10.699
    | text      = I just want things to be, my parents got divorced.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I just, I don't like change.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Let's keep it that way, I kinda like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:23.340

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:57.739
    | text      = There's something about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:59.619
    | text      = That like, I'm not a radical, I'm not a radical.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:31.900
    | text      = This energy is off-putting.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
